metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. KODAK motion picture film technical data sheet H-1-5277t (1996-03), 5277.pdf, PDF page(s) 4, KODAK VISION 320T Color Negative Film 5277 / 7277: https://125px.com/docs/motionpicture/kodak/5277.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): the characteristic curves are read on the printed camera-stop grid (1 stop = 0.30103 log H; the sheet's relative log-exposure ticks are hand-placed and agree within ~1%); the absolute exposure scale comes from the builder's speed-point anchoring; spectral sensitivity on the sheet's log scale, absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; individual C/M/Y dye curves printed peak-normalised: used as the start of the builder's dye reconstruction against the printed mid-scale neutral and D-min; dye densities outside the printed wavelength range; print stock: KODAK VISION 2383 (the shipped cine print profile; the contemporary 5386 / 2386 / 2393 era prints are not modelled separately); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives); hanatos2025 adaptation parameters borrowed from the shipped Kodak negatives (pinned donors). Original data are property of the respective holders.
